links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified ChatGPT responses to prostate cancer questions
links.outcome: Readability of patient-facing text (Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, Flesch Grade Level, Coleman Liau, SMOG, ARI); accuracy and sufficiency of simplified summaries
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease 36.5(9.1) v. 70.2(11.2), p<0.0001; Gunning Fog 15.8(1.7) v. 9.5(2.0); Flesch Grade Level 12.8(1.2) v. 7.4(1.7); Coleman Liau 13.7(2.1) v. 8.6(2.4); SMOG 11.8(1.2) v. 6.7(1.8); ARI 13.1(1.4) v. 7.5(2.1). Summaries rated accurate in 8/9 and sufficient for decision-making in 8/9 scenarios; MTurk workers rated them correct (89.5-95.7%) and understood content (63.0-87.4%).
links.tradeoff: One of 9 simplified summaries was not rated accurate or sufficient for decision-making; comprehension among lay raters was as low as 63.0% in some scenarios.
links.quote: Mean readability of layperson summaries was higher than original GPT outputs ([original ChatGPT v. simplified ChatGPT, mean (SD), p-value] Flesch Reading Ease: 36.5(9.1) v. 70.2(11.2), <0.0001; Gunning Fog: 15.8(1.7) v. 9.5(2.0), p < 0.0001; Flesch Grade Level: 12.8(1.2) v. 7.4(1.7), p < 0.0001; Coleman Liau: 13.7(2.1) v. 8.6(2.4), 0.0002; Smog index: 11.8(1.2) v. 6.7(1.8), <0.0001; Automated Readability Index: 13.1(1.4) v. 7.5(2.1), p < 0.0001).

links.comparator_used: Original ChatGPT prostate-cancer responses without a sixth-grade simplification instruction
links.outcome: Readability after prompting for sixth-grade layperson summaries
links.quote: Subsequently, these responses were re-inputted into ChatGPT to create simplified summaries understandable at a sixth-grade level.
